name: Timer & Alarm
description: Set alarms and timers by typing or speaking to Aruna, in Indonesian or English: "alarm besok jam 5 pagi", "set alarm tomorrow at 6 for the gym", "wake me up at 6", "timer mie 3 menit". Aruna reads each alarm back with its day, date and time of day before setting it. Alarms and timers ring with a Windows alarm sound and say what they are, even with Hariku in the tray; press any key to stop, or say "snooze". Manage them and choose the sounds in Preferences. Everything stays on your computer.
author: Rafli
